verdict.rationale: Ashby ships AI features (Assistant, AI Notetaker, AI rediscovery, MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question, but no first-party evidence documents any control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The only related item is a community report of a candidate form to opt out of AI resume processing that reportedly never worked. That concerns processing rather than training, is not a vendor-documented capability, and so cannot earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
